profile.name: Sourabh Salunke
profile.title: Business Analyst
profile.summary: Business Analyst with 3 years of experience analyzing performance trends and translating complex data into insights that inform senior leaders and drive measurable results at JCB India. Built automated Power BI dashboards and led root-cause analyses across 20+ supplier teams, turning raw data into recommendations that cross-functional stakeholders act on. Currently expanding technical capabilities in analytics and forecasting through a graduate degree program.

education.school: Purdue University, Daniels School of Business
education.degree: Master of Science in Business Analytics and Information Management
education.details: Relevant Coursework: Data Mining, Business Analysis, Management of Organizational Data

education.school: COEP Technological University, College of Engineering
education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering

bullets: Gathered operational requirements from internal stakeholder teams and led root-cause problem solving with 20+ supplier accounts to drive actionable process improvements.

Analyzed field failure data and performance metrics in 20+ supplier accounts using SQL and Power BI to isolate key drivers, recommending targeted improvements that reduced commodity issues PPM by 79% (2024-2025).

Developed a Power BI leakage-monitoring dashboard, converting raw operational quality data into actionable insights for cross- functional leadership presentations and driving a 48% overall reduction in leakages (75% across four key accounts).

Built automated KPI tracking dashboards to monitor high-value A-class component replacements, scoping process fixes for cross- functional stakeholders that reduced total replacements by 40%+ (2024–mid-2026).

Conducted biweekly fluid contamination tracking via Power BI by consolidating quality reports to test hypotheses, locate root causes, and partner with plant leaders to eliminate quality issues at the 2 underperforming facilities.

projects.title: Industry Practicum — Business Analyst (Team Project)
bullets: Partnering with a small business client to forecast inventory demand using historical sales data, informing stock-level decisions.
Building an order-monitoring website to track custom orders in real time for the business owner.

projects.title: Ad Click-Through Rate Prediction — Kaggle-Style Competition (QM 67000)
bullets: Built a binary classification model predicting ad-click probability on 60K+ impressions with missing data, mixed-scale features, and class imbalance (3% positive rate), evaluated via ROC-AUC.
Engineered features and trained an ensemble of LightGBM, XGBoost, and regularized logistic regression, validated with stratified 5-fold cross-validation to achieve 0.798 ROC-AUC.

projects.title: Stock Market - Data Visualization & Price Forecasting
bullets: Analyzed historical stock data for four companies through NumPy and Pandas to identify pricing trends.
Computed 9-, 14-, and 44-day moving averages and average daily returns to assess price trends and volatility.
Visualized price, volume, and cross-stock correlation using Matplotlib and Seaborn.
Built an LSTM model using TensorFlow to forecast future stock prices.
Supported satellite structural design by developing a deployable aluminum solar sail mechanism for space traversal.
Tested and refined the sail's deployment mechanism, improving performance through iterative design cycles.
Contributed to the design of an H-shaped Yagi-Uda antenna holding system.
